notes.title: 【Little Witch Nobeta】ASMR in the making! Scheduled for release this year!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/e570260832fdb6ac795b078f25b911a0b3c04e08.jpg

『Nobeta is adorable, I love her voice~』The dev team heard your voice！The main character in《Little Witch Nobeta》Nobeta and the Little Black Cat is featured by renowned Japanese voice actress Konomi Kohara. In addition to the main game, spin-off stories were released featuring other crafted souls in the game, as well as "Wandering in the Dream" detailing Nobeta emotional journey and the prequel "The Little Black Cat" both of which are dubbed! "Wanderer in the Dream" and "The Little Black Cat" are available on the official YouTube channel for free, peek into the characters' backgrounds while enjoying Ms. Kohara's and adorable voice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/8c919d535b479a6b47a3a23e3158dc115183ed6c.jpg

For detailed release date, as well as latest news for our merchandises, please follow Little Witch Nobeta on social media!

notes.title: 《Little Witch Nobeta》 animated comic 《Wanderer In The Dream》 release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=VWY3bulXkrk;full][/previewyoutube]
Every time Nobeta is defeated in the game she wakes up at 「Statue of Goddess」, for it looks like just a reviving mechanism in the game but little do the players know Nobeta have to go through cycles of life and death and carry on with these memories of agony.

After each death the world resets. She must endure endless battle with crafted soul until one of them meet their end. Facing these crafted souls of terror who continued to deliver death, she felt not resentful but a sense of familiarity. She listened to their last words and made promises as though they were close to her. Puzzled wanderer, will she find what she seeks at The Throne?

Through cycles of life and death she grows stronger and learns of her heart.
A story belongs to the player and the little witch.

notes.title: 【TGS】《Little Witch Nobeta》Full Game Release Confirmed 2022!
notes.notes:
《Little Witch Nobeta》is a 3D action adventure game which has reached over 200,000 global audiences. Player will play as the little witch and venture deep into the ancient castle to unveil the mystery of her past. The currently released version contains approximately 30 percent of content of what’s expected in the full game. The full released is expected to be released by 2022.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/f48047db661c12499b350bb3e125a5281727f2da.png

The demo video released today (10/1) on Tokyo Game Show 2021 Online revealed the new boss announced earlier this year. The development team released a three-minute-long video demonstrating the boss in combat.

[previewyoutube=wDn6-yWuLuk;full]LINK address[/previewyoutube]
  
Porting to consoles confirmed
The global console publisher for《Little Witch Nobeta》will be Justdan International Co., Ltd. (傑仕登股份有限公司), porting for Nintendo Switch™ and PlayStation®4 is in progress.

Brand new soul doll
After defeating countless dolls and wandering through the underground relic, a doll with blonde hair dressed in scarlet appears in the hall of throne awaiting your arrival. Arrogant yet elegant, her key-shaped sword is capable of summoning infinite spears. Just like you, she claims to be a seeker of the throne. What’s the hidden secret of the throne? What’s the power it possesses? 
 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/62eb3f018d427086e6130c012abceab156ada67b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/8ec4d1a8ab6a6528abc4d632b600899396e03609.png

Hololive collaboration 
《Little Witch Nobeta》is collaborating with the virtual YouTuber brand Hololive Production by COVER Corp. The three bosses: Ribbon Loving Soul Doll – Tania, Doll Hugging Soul Doll – Monica, and Soul Doll of The Throne – Vanessa will be voiced by Omaru Polka, Shirakami Fubuki and Shirogane Noel.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/bcff3893887d53f226711279ca4d878ff949f19d.png
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/a8ba933c846c650a58cef2469d4ca5e4830e8433.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780206/eb3db38964b7c13c7b46d9a99a9cd747eb3c1ecf.png
 
The collaboration was proposed by the development team to COVER Corp. since September 2020. By June 2021, the voice recording was finalised. The three Vtubers will perform in a different setting from their usual streaming voice to bring the global audience an unique audio experience.
